description: This source file contains unit tests for the NATS streaming client in an Orleans-based project. It defines the NatsClientStreamTests class which sets up and tears down NATS stream connections, configures test cluster builder, and includes test methods for NATS streaming behavior.

classes.name: NatsClientStreamTests
classes.description: Unit test class for NATS streaming client functionalities within Orleans, including setup and teardown of NATS streams, cluster configuration, and a specific streaming test case.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add NATS streams and memory storage.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client builder to add NATS streams.

methods.name: NatsClientStreamTests()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NATS connection and context, and skips test if NATS server is unavailable.

methods.name: InitializeAsync()
methods.description: Async method to connect to NATS, delete existing stream if present, and initialize the test runner.

methods.name: DisposeAsync()
methods.description: Async cleanup method to delete NATS stream and dispose of connections.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster()
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with NATS stream provider and storage.
